mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods with FEDFUNDS declining for 3 consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate falls below 3.5% for two consecutive months, it signals a tight labor market that boosts consumer spending and corporate profits, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when UNRATE has been below 3.5% for two consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in retail sales (RSAFS) and housing starts (HOUST) indicates robust consumer and business confidence, which together drive a positive equity market reaction over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal of rising RSAFS and HOUST fails to produce positive 20-day returns in more than 55% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: During a monetary tightening cycle (FEDFUNDS rising above 4.0%), the S&P 500 experiences negative returns over the next 60 trading days as higher borrowing costs dampen corporate investment and consumer spending.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS has been above 4.0% for 3 consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) over the past 6 months indicates strong labor market conditions that support rising corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods with PAYEMS growth exceeding 100k per month for 6 consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: When retail sales (RSAFS) growth exceeds 0.5% month-over-month for two consecutive months, it signals strong consumer demand that boosts corporate revenues and drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when RSAFS growth has exceeded 0.5% for two consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) is rising and housing starts (HOUST) are above 1400 thousand units, it indicates a synchronized expansion in manufacturing and construction sectors, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal of INDPRO > 100 and HOUST > 1400 fails to produce positive 60-day returns in more than 55% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: When the year-over-year change in CPI (CPIAUCSL) exceeds 3.0%, it signals persistent inflation that triggers a Fed response, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when CPIAUCSL YoY growth exceeds 3.0%.
